item.title: Vilardi props up Jets with two goals in 5-1 win over Capitals
item.description: WINNIPEG — Gabriel Vilardi scored twice and star goaltender Connor Hellebuyck made 24 saves in his first game back from injury to power the Jets to a 5-1 victory over the Washington Capitals on Saturday that snapped Winnipeg's three-game losing skid.

item.title: 'Very exciting': Tristan Jarry reflects on trade to Edmonton Oilers
item.description: TORONTO — Tristan Jarry was at home Friday morning when his phone rang. Pittsburgh Penguins general manager and president of hockey operations Kyle Dubas was on the line. He needed to see the veteran goaltender right away.

item.title: Miller scores twice, including OT winner, as Rangers edge Canadiens 5-4
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — J.T. Miller scored his second goal of the game on a power play at 2:56 of overtime as the New York Rangers rallied to beat the Montreal Canadiens 5-4 on Saturday night.

item.title: Abbotsford floodwaters recede but more rain in store for B.C.'s Fraser Valley
Hellebuyck all smiles in winning return from knee surgery
item.description: WINNIPEG — Connor Hellebuyck was flashing some smiles after his return from injury helped the Winnipeg Jets take down the Washington Capitals 5-1 on Saturday.

item.title: U.S. downs Canada 4-1 in women's hockey, sweeps Rivalry Series
item.description: EDMONTON — Hilary Knight scored twice, including an empty-netter, to lead the United States to a 4-1 win over Canada in a women's hockey Rivalry Series game Saturday. The U.S. swept the four-game series and outscored Canada 24-7.

item.title: Police search Brown University after shooter kills 2 and wounds 9 on campus
item.description: PROVIDENCE, R.I. (AP) — A shooter dressed in black killed at least two people and wounded nine others at Brown University on Saturday during final exams on the Ivy League campus, authorities said, and police were searching for the suspect.

item.title: Morgan Frost scores in OT to lift Flames past the Kings 2-1
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Morgan Frost scored in overtime and Blake Coleman had a short-handed goal in the Calgary Flames’ 2-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night. Dustin Wolf made 20 saves for the surging Flames.

item.title: NHL roundup: Devils dumps Ducks 4-1 to snap five-game home losing skid
item.description: NEWARK, N.J. (AP) — Stefan Noesen, Paul Cotter and Cody Glass each scored to help the New Jersey Devils beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-1 on Saturday and snap a five-game home losing streak.
